title: A Contingency Argument Without the PSR
content: Traditional cosmological arguments are often thought to rely fatally on the Principle of Sufficient Reason. This paper develops a contingency argument that does not. To analyse certain metalinguistic statements, we employ a two-sorted first-order logic supplemented with axioms and predicates mirroring features of the QKB modal system. Within this framework, we formulate four axioms, each verified via Mace4 to be consistent and independent both from one another and from the PSR. We provide philosophical justification for each axiom and outline a formal proof in Lean 4 demonstrating that, taken together, they entail the existence of a necessary entity.
